name: Dub Techno
description: Deep, dark and spacious: soft sub-kick, filtered chord stabs drowned in wide delays, rolled-off top.
notes: Basic Channel / Chain Reaction lineage: deep and dark, top end deliberately dull.
The width comes from delays and reverb on the chords; keep the low end mono.
More dynamic than peak-time techno: around -10 LUFS.
source: hand-tuned estimate from genre conventions (not measured from a track corpus)
